n. (-लं)
A sort of poison: see हलाहल.

m. (-हा)
A Gandharba or chorister of heaven; also हाहा

m. (-हाः)
A Gandharba, a demi-god of an inferior order, attendant on KUVERA and the other gods, and especially the chanter of their praises.
ind.
An interjection of surprise, or grief, or pain.
E.
हा alas, interjection of sorrow, हा to abandon, क्विप् aff., or with असि, aff. हाहस्, or हा interjection repeated.

m. (-हाः)
A Gandharba, a celestial being of an inferior order.

m. (-रः)
1 The noise or uproar of battle.
2 Lamentation, sound of grief or pity.
E.
हाहा interjection of pain, कार making.
